about_the_game:
You are not the adventurer. You are not the hero. You are the skeleton.

Awakening in a dark, forgotten chamber, you find yourself lying beside a locked chest—the kind every adventurer dreams of looting. But this time the roles are reversed. You’re the bones on the floor, and the mystery of why you’re here—and how to escape—will take wit, nerve, and a taste for dark humor to unravel.

Every choice you make shapes your fate. Will you claw your way to freedom, uncovering the secrets buried within these walls? Or will you trap yourself forever in the vault, just another cautionary tale for the next adventurer to

stumble upon?

Features:

  • Trope turned on its head: play as the skeleton next to the chest instead of the adventurer looting it.

  • Multiple paths, multiple endings: escape routes, dead ends, or a fate worse than death—your choices decide.

  • Mystery meets dark comedy: blend of detective work, eerie atmosphere, and a twisted sense of humor.

  • Replayable design: every playthrough reveals new possibilities and secrets.

  • A touch of horror: lurking tension and unsettling discoveries keep you on edge.

Shattered Vault is a story-driven, choice-based mystery with a sharp wit and sinister undertones. The only way forward is through the choices you make. Will you escape the vault… or become part of it?

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / SteamOS
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM, Mesa 21.0+)
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan support. Performance may vary depending on GPU drivers and desktop environment.
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS / SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6600 / NVIDIA RTX 3060 (6–8 GB VRAM, latest Mesa/NVIDIA drivers)
  • Additional Notes: Best experienced with Vulkan drivers up-to-date. Runs smoothly at 1080p–1440p with all visual features enabled

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 (2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 720p–1080p gameplay. Volumetric effects may reduce performance on older GPUs.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600X / Intel Core i5-12400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD RX 6600 / NVIDIA RTX 3060 (6–8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Additional Notes: Runs smoothly at 1080p–1440p with all visual features enabled.
